name: Senait
face: Young Eritrean girl with warm medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, a small nose, and a bright open smile.
clothing: Ankle-length white zuria with floral and geometric embroidery in red, blue, yellow, and green at the V-neck, sleeve cuffs, and hem, a white sash, and a white fringed netela shawl with matching embroidered borders over her shoulders. White socks and brown leather sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
dominantColor: White with red, blue, yellow, and green embroidery
distinctiveFeatures: Short dense black curls, small gold hoop earrings, and the embroidered white netela draped over both shoulders.
